ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the main body to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels along the edges and focal marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black perimeter banding along the trailing edges. Distinct vertical low-intensity streaking adjacent to the median notch and scattered focal dark spots primarily on the lower quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees and a deep depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the left lobe trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude, irregular indentations and a jagged, non-uniform termination near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve observed along the leading edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized high-intensity white circular clusters (indicative of barnacle attachment sites) visible on the dark-pigmented leading edge of the left lobe. Isolated white point-pixel clusters scattered across the central light field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-intensity vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) originating near the median notch and extending ventrally. Short horizontal linear marks visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, creating a non-symmetrical contour compared to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark diagonal linear mark located on the extreme lower left boundary of the left lobe surface.
